newsitem.title: USA: Former congressman found guilty of fraud.
newsitem.headline: Former congressman found guilty of fraud.

text.p: Former U.S. Representative Mel Reynolds, serving a five-year sentence for sexual misconduct and obstruction of justice, was found guilty Wednesday of financial fraud.

A federal court jury, after deliberating only a few hours, found Reynolds guilty of more than a dozen counts against him. He was charged with offences ranging from illegally converting campaign contributions to cash to deceiving banks and the Federal Election Commission.
The Justice Department alleged that he lied about debts so he could borrow more money.

The fraud charges were filed after Reynolds was convicted of sexual misconduct involving an under-age campaign worker. The Chicago Democrat resigned his seat in Congress after his conviction on the earlier charges.
